text:
Hi,

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’m passionate, hard-working, and ready to contribute to your team as a Real Estate Client Relations Specialist. With 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, data visualization, SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, I’ve developed a strong foundation in organization, fast-paced task handling, and maintaining accuracy while working across multiple priorities.

While my background is centered on data and operations, the core strengths you’re looking for—quick response time, multitasking, clear communication, and reliable task completion—are exactly the way I work. I’m comfortable switching between several responsibilities at once, staying organized under pressure, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. I understand the importance of immediate action, proactive follow-up, and keeping communication moving without delay.

I’m confident handling structured workflows, maintaining detailed records, and supporting client-facing processes with care and professionalism. I also value efficiency and consistency, which makes me a strong fit for a role where prompt response and task completion are essential. I can adapt quickly to new systems and processes, and I’m prepared to learn and apply the specific tools you use, including Follow Up Boss, Realtor.com, Zillow, and social media engagement platforms.

In addition, I bring strong problem-solving skills and a disciplined work style that supports time-sensitive tasks and rapid task switching. I understand that this role requires someone who can move quickly, seek clarification when needed, and stay accountable to deadlines. That is the kind of working style I bring to every role.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute dependable support, strong organization, and responsive communication to your real estate operations. Thank you for considering my application, and I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can help.
